# snipeit_company (Data Source)

Looks up a single company by `id` or exact `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "snipeit_company" "acme" {
  name = "ACME Corp"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the company. Set it to look up by id.
- `name` (String) Name of the company. Set it to look up by exact name.

### Read-Only

- `email` (String) Email address of the company.
- `fax` (String) Fax number of the company.
- `notes` (String) Free-form notes.
- `phone` (String) Phone number of the company.
